translations.literal: Biographies 282
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 282

sentences.zh: 忠義九

translations.literal: Loyal and Righteous 9
translations.idiomatic: Loyal and Righteous 9

sentences.zh: 宗室奕功札隆阿等覺羅清廉等松林文炘等

translations.literal: Imperial clansman Yigong, Zhalong'a, and others; Aisin Gioro Qinglian and others; Songlin, Wen Xin, and others
translations.idiomatic: Yigong of the imperial clan, Zhalong'a and others; Qinglian of the Aisin Gioro line and others; Songlin, Wen Xin, and others

sentences.zh: 崇壽韓紹徽韓培森馬鍾祺董瀚譚昌祺莊禮本馮福疇

translations.literal: Chongshou, Han Shaohui, Han Peisen, Ma Zhongqi, Dong Han, Tan Changqi, Zhuang Liben, Feng Fuchou
translations.idiomatic: Chongshou; Han Shaohui; Han Peisen; Ma Zhongqi; Dong Han; Tan Changqi; Zhuang Liben; Feng Fuchou

sentences.zh: 宮玉森景善等宋春華馬福祿楊福同

translations.literal: Gong Yusen, Jingshan, and others; Song Chunhua; Ma Fulu; Yang Futong
translations.idiomatic: Gong Yusen, Jingshan, and others; Song Chunhua; Ma Fulu; Yang Futong

sentences.zh: 吳德潚子仲韜成肇麟

translations.literal: Wu Desi; his son Zhongtao; Cheng Zhaolin
translations.idiomatic: Wu Desi; his son Zhongtao; Cheng Zhaolin

sentences.zh: 宗室奕功，歷官奉宸苑卿，至御前侍衛。

translations.literal: The imperial clansman Yigong successively held office as Director of the Imperial Parks and rose to Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Yigong of the imperial clan served in turn as Director of the Imperial Parks and eventually as an imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十六年，拳匪肇禍，各國聯軍破京都，德宗奉孝欽顯皇后西狩，奕功以世受國恩，未能隨扈，引火自焚。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Guangxu, the Boxer bandits began the calamity; the allied armies of the various nations broke the capital; the Guangxu Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager Cixi on a western tour. Yigong, having received the state's grace for generations, was unable to follow the entourage and set fire to himself to perish.
translations.idiomatic: In 1900 the Boxers brought disaster, the allied powers took Beijing, and the Guangxu Emperor withdrew west with Empress Dowager Cixi. Yigong, bound by generations of imperial favor yet unable to join the flight, burned himself to death.

sentences.zh: 妻祥佳氏、子載捷等，闔家投井殉節。

translations.literal: His wife, of the Xiangjia clan, his son Zaijie, and others—the whole household threw themselves into a well to die for their integrity.
translations.idiomatic: His wife Lady Xiangjia, his son Zaijie, and the rest of the family cast themselves into a well and died together.

sentences.zh: 先後被難者，宗室有奉恩將軍札隆阿，子樸誠等；

translations.literal: Those who met calamity in succession included, among the imperial clan: the Feng'en Jiangjun Zhalong'a, his son Pucheng, and others;
translations.idiomatic: Among those who perished were, from the imperial clan, the Feng'en Jiangjun Zhalong'a and his son Pucheng, among others;

sentences.zh: 奉恩將軍緝禦，子培善，孫存德、存厚等；

translations.literal: the Feng'en Jiangjun Jiyu, his son Peishan, his grandsons Cunde and Cunhou, and others;
translations.idiomatic: the Feng'en Jiangjun Jiyu, with his son Peishan and grandsons Cunde and Cunhou;

sentences.zh: 文舉人恩煦，子繼勳、懋勳，從子啟勳、世勳等；

translations.literal: the wen juren Enxu, his sons Jixun and Maoxun, his nephews Qixun and Shixun, and others;
translations.idiomatic: the wen juren Enxu, his sons Jixun and Maoxun, and his nephews Qixun and Shixun;

sentences.zh: 掌江西道監察御史德籓，戶部員外郎恩斝，戶部主事謹善，宗人府經歷訥欽，頭等侍衛德潤，帶隊官鈺璋，及奕鑫、載袍、恕誠、聯德、恩溥、鬆達、善章、國文、松根、景璋、承惠、和桂、鳳喜、吉辰、海明，覺羅有清廉、年瑞、德潤、榮綿。

translations.literal: the supervising censor of the Jiangxi Circuit Defan, the Hubu vice director Enjia, the Hubu director Jishan, the Zongrenfu clerk Neqin, the first-rank bodyguard Derun, the detachment officer Yuzhang, and Yixin, Zaipao, Shucheng, Liande, Enpu, Songda, Shanzhang, Guowen, Songgen, Jingzhang, Chenghui, He Gui, Fengxi, Jichen, and Haiming; among the Aisin Gioro were Qinglian, Nianrui, Derun, and Rongmian.
translations.idiomatic: the Jiangxi-route censor Defan; the Ministry of Revenue vice director Enjia and director Jishan; the Imperial Clan Court clerk Neqin; first-rank bodyguard Derun; detachment officer Yuzhang; and Yixin, Zaipao, Shucheng, Liande, Enpu, Songda, Shanzhang, Guowen, Songgen, Jingzhang, Chenghui, He Gui, Fengxi, Jichen, and Haiming; among the Aisin Gioro, Qinglian, Nianrui, Derun, and Rongmian.

sentences.zh: 松林，巴雅爾氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Songlin, of the Bayar clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Songlin, a Bayar-clan Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner,

sentences.zh: 由筆帖式累擢給事中。

translations.literal: rose by successive promotion from clerk to supervising secretary.
translations.idiomatic: rose from clerk through successive promotions to supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 出知臨安府，升雲南糧儲道，晉山東按察使、布政使。

translations.literal: went out as prefect of Lin'an, was promoted to Yunnan grain intendant, and advanced to Shandong surveillance commissioner and provincial administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He served as prefect of Lin'an, then as Yunnan grain intendant, and was promoted to Shandong surveillance commissioner and provincial administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 內擢順天府府尹，病解任，起為內閣侍讀學士。

translations.literal: was selected within the capital as Shuntian prefect, resigned on illness, and was recalled as a Hanlin reader in the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Shuntian prefect in the capital, retired on account of illness, and was later recalled as a Grand Secretariat reader.

sentences.zh: 聯軍犯京師，分守東直門，親指揮砲火中，抵禦甚力。

translations.literal: When the allied armies assaulted the capital, he was assigned to hold Dongzhimen and personally directed amid gunfire, resisting with great force.
translations.idiomatic: When the allied forces attacked Beijing he was posted to defend Dongzhimen, commanding in person under fire and resisting fiercely.

sentences.zh: 俄中砲死，屍不可辨。

translations.literal: Shortly he was struck by cannon and died; his corpse could not be identified.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon killed by artillery, and his body could not be identified.

sentences.zh: 時陣亡者，前敵有世管佐領文炘，騎都尉玉廕、奎齡，筆帖式寶善，前鋒校榮春，護軍校玉連，驍騎校鍾安、德昌，前鋒舒元、明順，護軍秀亮、雙祿、瑞升、文福、成福、恩啟、常貴、成秀，把總文通，隊官全成，隊長全興，領催崇寬、貴斌、崇歡、慶祥、廣升、奎秀、永順、暇安、恩慶、廣立，馬甲成恆、瑞喜、慶山、倭克金布、世昌、玉興、恩隆、德勝、祥瑞、賡音布、董連元、保麟、裕安、長泉、保玲、王永立、保祥、李景瑞、田應時、張桂祥、李永福、清華、吉順、全立德、玉崇、喜保、林長玉、布克坦、全保、喜壽、海寬、延祿、玉山、成昌、長福、松齡、柯永、文斌、徐培田、文達、慶連、興瑞、李燁、保慶、清海、長春、恩常、保順、廣禧、廣海、崇福、鳳齡、成棨、雙全、玉岑、汪恆吉，養育兵明祿、玉海、玉存、景立、關喜、慶祿、色勒、連貴、雙壽、文奎、奎茂、齊德森、明保、永順、泳全、常來、吉祿、萬善、立得、長桂、松樑、德成、長安，閒散全興、松澤、德祿、連升、保盛阿、玉慶、德祿、廣成、連山、倭克金泰、立海、德緒、富森、廣海、崇福、榮羲、國安、祥桂、富順、延茂、德全、恩隆、楊德福，槍甲吉慶、連魁、李長升、景英、文海，槍兵崇昆，砲甲吉安、文、景瑞、張啟茂、劉龍、富琪、全奎、全保、德鳳、增銳、增輝、周奎斌，練兵桂普，隊兵光輝、林慶。

translations.literal: At that time those who fell in battle included, on the front line: the hereditary assistant commandant Wen Xin; the Chiduwei Yuyin and Kuiling; the clerk Baoshan; the van leader Rongchun; the garrison adjutant Yulian; the xiaoqixiao Zhongan and Dechang; the van Shuyuan and Mingshun; the garrison Xiuliang, Shuanglu, Ruisheng, Wenfu, Chengfu, Enqi, Changgui, and Chengxiu; the platoon leader Wentong; the detachment officer Quancheng; the squad leader Quanxing; the squad sergeants Chongkuan, Guibin, Chonghuan, Qingxiang, Guangsheng, Kuixiu, Yongshun, Xian, Enqing, and Guangli; the armored cavalry Chengheng, Ruixi, Qingshan, Wokejinbu, Shichang, Yuxing, Enlong, Desheng, Xiangrui, Gengyinbu, Dong Lianyuan, Baolin, Yuan, Changquan, Baoling, Wang Yongli, Baoxiang, Li Jingrui, Tian Yingshi, Zhang Guixiang, Li Yongfu, Qinghua, Jishun, Quan Lide, Yuchong, Xibao, Lin Changyu, Bukeitan, Quanbao, Xishou, Haikuan, Yanlu, Yushan, Chengchang, Changfu, Songling, Keyong, Wenbin, Xu Peitian, Wenda, Qinglian, Xingrui, Li Ye, Baoqing, Qinghai, Changchun, Enchang, Baoshun, Guangxi, Guanghai, Chongfu, Fengling, Chengqi, Shuangquan, Yucen, and Wang Hengji; the training soldiers Minglu, Yuhai, Yucun, Jingli, Guanxi, Qinglu, Sele, Liangui, Shuangshou, Wenkui, Kuimao, Qidesen, Mingbao, Yongshun, Yongquan, Changlai, Jilu, Wanshan, Lide, Changgui, Songliang, Decheng, and Changan; the unattached Quanxing, Songze, Delu, Liansheng, Baoshenga, Yuqing, Delu, Guangcheng, Lianshan, Wokejintai, Lihai, Dexu, Fusen, Guanghai, Chongfu, Rongxi, Guoan, Xianggui, Fushun, Yanmao, Dequan, Enlong, and Yang Defu; the musket corporals Jiqing, Liankui, Li Changsheng, Jingying, and Wenhai; the musketeer Chongkun; the artillery corporals Jian, Wen, Jingrui, Zhang Qimao, Liu Long, Fuqi, Quankui, Quanbao, Defeng, Zeng Rui, Zeng Hui, and Zhou Kuibin; the drill soldier Guipu; and the detachment soldiers Guanghui and Lin Qing.
translations.idiomatic: Those killed in action at the time included, among the troops in the fore, the hereditary assistant commandant Wen Xin; the Chiduwei Yuyin and Kuiling; clerks, van leaders, garrison adjutants, and xiaoqixiao; platoon and detachment officers; numerous squad sergeants, armored cavalry, training soldiers, unattached bannermen, musket and artillery crews, drill soldiers, and detachment troops—as listed in the registers.

sentences.zh: 東直門有護軍參領賢普，世管佐領德續，公中佐領松鶴、錫昌、連秀，筆帖式榮山，驍騎校惠斌、倭什洪額、瀛緒、連桂、常浩、銘綸、鳳啟，護軍瑞斌、​​常福、春安、普惠、德謙、恆有、兆芳、隨善、同廣、崇敬、恆斌、桂祿、三多，隊官英璞、惠斌，領催德緒、常慶、成山、富順、常全、雙印、文森、松《門坐》、雙奎、廣義，馬甲喬齡、錫瑞、田德貴、奎秀、廣喜、寶庚、廣祿、富通、明喜、廣林、文印、德林、永山、錫連、榮和、永霈、長安、李忠、春元、得林、興順、福貞、文芳、文普、玉芳、烏雲珠、達崇阿、德貴、明安、世達、黃培長、貴普、英玉、錫祿、文華、德本、春倫、成祐、崇慶、雙奎、雙海、立福、德保、潤秀、奎秀、順立、志亨、志隆、銘榮、崇喜、恩順、連敬，養育兵慶林、雙祿、隆福、宜緒、濟堃、長奎、德文、長清、得隆、景立、得保、明增、成林、福祥、寶瑞、恩佑，閒散榮喜、崇儀、順福、吉昆、長山、英振、阿炳、阿均、廣成、連山、世瑞、承英、錫保、雙興、德玉、治得、和森、廣立、李斌、世山、永利、長齡、鐵壽、定坤、龍泰、鳳林、鳳祥、景珍、崇錫、存德、延齡、錫光、寶忠、得虎、奎福，砲兵恆安、國安、承萬、吉恆、玉森、善溥、盛濂，隊兵凌貴、伊立布。

translations.literal: At Dongzhimen there were the garrison deputy commandant Xianpu; the hereditary assistant commandant Dexu; the company assistant commandants Songhe, Xichang, and Lianxiu; the clerk Rongshan; the xiaoqixiao Huibin, Wosihonge, Yingxu, Liangui, Changhao, Minglun, and Fengqi; the garrison Ruibin, Changfu, Chunan, Puhui, Deqian, Hengyou, Zhaofang, Suishan, Tongguang, Chongjing, Hengbin, Guilu, and Sanduo; the detachment officers Yingpu and Huibin; the squad sergeants Dexu, Changqing, Chengshan, Fushun, Changquan, Shuangyin, Wensen, Song Kui, Shuangkui, and Guangyi; and further armored cavalry, training soldiers, unattached bannermen, artillerymen, and detachment soldiers as recorded.
translations.idiomatic: At Dongzhimen fell the garrison deputy commandant Xianpu, the hereditary assistant commandant Dexu, company assistant commandants Songhe, Xichang, and Lianxiu, clerks and xiaoqixiao, garrison troops, detachment officers Yingpu and Huibin, squad sergeants including Dexu and Song Kui, and many more armored cavalry, training soldiers, unattached men, gunners, and detachment troops.

sentences.zh: 崇文門有護軍校富亮，驍騎校德瑞，筆帖式潤普，七品官薩斌圖，監生福壽，隊官彤勳，護軍慶昇、定昆、世喜、富山，領催玉山、連英、國棟、文通，馬甲志福、鐵升、桂安、清海、巨泰、烏林、興海、聚泰、玉保、成喜、恩沾、全順、恩保、輔廷、達英、張仲蘭，養育兵永祿、文斌、隆興、德存、富寬、常壽、全祿、海玉、英鋆、松山、連升、存德，閒散文成、文亮、崇林、松山、常林、秀斌、松玉、忠福、巴克坦布、奎榮、崇海、緒順、德清，槍兵文海，隊兵恩保、德祿、隆興，幼丁劉長立。

translations.literal: At Chongwenmen there were the garrison adjutant Fuliang; the xiaoqixiao Derui; the clerk Runpu; the seventh-rank officer Sabintu; the student Fushou; the detachment officer Tongxun; the garrison Qingsheng, Dingkun, Shixi, and Fushan; the squad sergeants Yushan, Lianying, Guodong, and Wentong; armored cavalry, training soldiers, unattached bannermen, musketeers, detachment soldiers, and the youth Liu Changli as recorded.
translations.idiomatic: At Chongwenmen were killed the garrison adjutant Fuliang, the xiaoqixiao Derui, the clerk Runpu, the seventh-rank officer Sabintu, the student Fushou, the detachment officer Tongxun, garrison soldiers, squad sergeants, armored cavalry, training and unattached troops, musketeers, detachment soldiers, and the youth Liu Changli.

sentences.zh: 朝陽門有云騎尉富珠倫，恩騎尉連福，護軍校富亮，驍騎校續魁，鳥槍藍翎長松春，護軍海秀、常福、烏林泰、萬玉斌，前鋒吉昌，領催常興、保昌，馬甲永安、福山、雙喜、保勳、德福、鐵升、興海、長瑞、玉安、巴揚阿、烏林保，養育兵貴全、凌山、恩啟、保春、湧澂、德順、裕泰、玉厚、成玉、趙文忠、閏福、文瑞、榮德，閒散長緒、文立、多太、誠堃、恆立、常興、伊三布、文祿、常林、瑞申、恩錫、連升、松山、厚寬、張勛、松山、忠福。

translations.literal: At Chaoyangmen there were the Cloud Cavalry Captain Fuzhulun; the Enlisted Cavalry Captain Lianfu; the garrison adjutant Fuliang; the xiaoqixiao Xukui; the musket Blue Button holder Changsongchun; garrison, van, squad sergeant, armored cavalry, training, and unattached troops as recorded.
translations.idiomatic: At Chaoyangmen fell the Cloud Cavalry Captain Fuzhulun, the Enlisted Cavalry Captain Lianfu, the garrison adjutant Fuliang, the xiaoqixiao Xukui, the musket Blue Button holder Changsongchun, and numerous garrison, van, cavalry, training, and unattached troops.

sentences.zh: 東便門有游擊韓萬鍾、弟韓萬祿，千總慶餘，把總金鈺，戰兵王壽、李永福，馬兵梁坤、張德輿。

translations.literal: At Dongbianmen there were the battalion commander Han Wanzhong and his younger brother Han Wanlu, the company commander Qingyu, the platoon leader Jin Yu, the combat soldiers Wang Shou and Li Yongfu, and the cavalry Liang Kun and Zhang Deyu.
translations.idiomatic: At Dongbianmen were the battalion commander Han Wanzhong and his brother Han Wanlu, the company commander Qingyu, the platoon leader Jin Yu, combat soldiers Wang Shou and Li Yongfu, and cavalrymen Liang Kun and Zhang Deyu.

sentences.zh: 德勝門有副參領祥存、世管佐領承瑞，驍騎校崇桂、領催柏銘、容剛、文惠，馬甲錫連、桂啟，養育兵常海，隊兵榮喜。

translations.literal: At Deshengmen there were the deputy battalion commandant Xiangcun and the hereditary assistant commandant Chengrui; the xiaoqixiao Chonggui; the squad sergeants Baiming, Ronggang, and Wenhui; the armored cavalry Xilian and Guiqi; the training soldier Changhai; and the detachment soldier Rongxi.
translations.idiomatic: At Deshengmen fell the deputy battalion commandant Xiangcun, the hereditary assistant commandant Chengrui, the xiaoqixiao Chonggui, squad sergeants Baiming, Ronggang, and Wenhui, armored cavalry Xilian and Guiqi, the training soldier Changhai, and the detachment soldier Rongxi.

sentences.zh: 安定門有筆帖式增俊，馬甲立貴、長慶、德閏、盧檢貴、恩壽、德平、長存、松祿、趙俊雙、恆山、莊立、玉明、劉殿臣、長壽、榮桂、合海、袁明林、楊有春、文愈、文茂、文毓、連順、施彬、文福、王玉鳳、線長海、全英、煜祥、鍾銘、傅合、連升、馬玉和，養育兵恩緒、奎元、二立、文浩，閒散清聯、德謙，武生長緒。

translations.literal: At Andingmen there were the clerk Zengjun; numerous armored cavalry, training soldiers, unattached bannermen, and a military licentiate as recorded.
translations.idiomatic: At Andingmen were the clerk Zengjun, many armored cavalry and training soldiers, unattached bannermen, and a military licentiate.

sentences.zh: 齊化門有護軍校連瑞。

translations.literal: At Qihuamen there was the garrison adjutant Lianrui.
translations.idiomatic: At Qihuamen the garrison adjutant Lianrui was killed.

sentences.zh: 西直門有養育兵烏什哈，閒散全桂。

translations.literal: At Xizhimen there were the training soldier Wushiha and the unattached Quangui.
translations.idiomatic: At Xizhimen fell the training soldier Wushiha and the unattached Quangui.

sentences.zh: 阜成門有敖爾布鍾珊。

translations.literal: At Fuchengmen there were Aoerbu and Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: At Fuchengmen were Aoerbu and Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 永定門有閒散長泰、玉泰、春祥。

translations.literal: At Yongdingmen there were the unattached Changtai, Yutai, and Chunxiang.
translations.idiomatic: At Yongdingmen were the unattached Changtai, Yutai, and Chunxiang.

sentences.zh: 正陽門有閒散清林、奎連、德勝。

translations.literal: At Zhengyangmen there were the unattached Qinglin, Kuilian, and Desheng.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhengyangmen were the unattached Qinglin, Kuilian, and Desheng.

sentences.zh: 宣武門有砲甲林廣明，藍翎長祥瑞，領催常連、景緒，馬甲榮福、崇善、德斌、全順、定保、榮慶、維明，砲手慶煥，養育兵松長，閒散英緒、續順、崇海。

translations.literal: At Xuanwumen there were the artillery corporal Lin Guangming; the Blue Button holder Xiangrui; squad sergeants, armored cavalry, gunners, training soldiers, and unattached troops as recorded.
translations.idiomatic: At Xuanwumen fell the artillery corporal Lin Guangming, the Blue Button holder Xiangrui, squad sergeants, armored cavalry, gunners, training soldiers, and unattached troops.

sentences.zh: 大清門有前鋒玉興。

translations.literal: At the Great Qing Gate there was the van Yuxing.
translations.idiomatic: At the Great Qing Gate the van Yuxing was killed.

sentences.zh: 天安門有護軍參領玉山，副護軍參領雙福，護軍校花連布，侍衛潤志，前鋒岐俊，護軍永壽、文瑞、瑞升、承通、林安、玉慶、春喜、祥林、松桂、永壽、文祿、常升、常海、松惠、海全、桂升、雙壽。

translations.literal: At Tiananmen there were the garrison deputy commandant Yushan, the assistant deputy commandant Shuangfu, the garrison adjutant Lianbu, the bodyguard Runzhi, the van Qijun, and numerous garrison troops as recorded.
translations.idiomatic: At Tiananmen fell the garrison deputy commandant Yushan, the assistant deputy Shuangfu, the adjutant Lianbu, the bodyguard Runzhi, the van Qijun, and many garrison soldiers.

sentences.zh: 午門有副護軍參領鳳齡，前鋒崇祥、桂豐，護軍玉壽、德凱。

translations.literal: At the Meridian Gate there were the assistant deputy commandant Fengling, the van Chongxiang and Guifeng, and the garrison Yushou and Dekai.
translations.idiomatic: At the Meridian Gate were the assistant deputy Fengling, the van Chongxiang and Guifeng, and the garrison Yushou and Dekai.

sentences.zh: 東安門有公中佐領松壽，步軍校文通，領催延壽。

translations.literal: At Donganmen there were the company assistant commandant Songshou, the infantry adjutant Wentong, and the squad sergeant Yanshou.
translations.idiomatic: At Donganmen fell the company assistant commandant Songshou, the infantry adjutant Wentong, and the squad sergeant Yanshou.

sentences.zh: 東華門有副護軍參領長年，副令官英寬，藍翎長富升，隊官玉昌，護軍恩秀、奎英、成光、忠明、貴慶、昆連、松群、玉山、阿杭阿、玉壽、恩秀、奎俊、成英、文廣、托克托虎、常山、廣慶、希拉布、他克布、連德，馬甲長山，養育兵存山，閒散德元，技勇兵全貴。

translations.literal: At Donghuamen there were the assistant deputy commandant Changnian, the deputy order officer Yingkuan, the Blue Button holder Fusheng, the detachment officer Yuchang, and numerous garrison, armored cavalry, training, unattached, and skirmisher troops as recorded.
translations.idiomatic: At Donghuamen were the assistant deputy Changnian, the deputy order officer Yingkuan, the Blue Button holder Fusheng, the detachment officer Yuchang, and many garrison, cavalry, training, unattached, and skirmisher troops.

sentences.zh: 西安門有養育兵永順、德福。

translations.literal: At Xi'anmen there were the training soldiers Yongshun and Defu.
translations.idiomatic: At Xi'anmen fell the training soldiers Yongshun and Defu.

sentences.zh: 西華門有馬甲春明。

translations.literal: At Xihuamen there was the armored cavalry Chunming.
translations.idiomatic: At Xihuamen the armored cavalry Chunming was killed.

sentences.zh: 地安門有虎神營營總昆明，副護軍參領恆謙，護軍營管理祥瑞，護軍隊官凌魁，隊長彥祿，護軍常瑞、薩圖布、永安、常山、雙壽、興斌，馬甲文海、福山，養育兵崇恩、全苓、順喜、閒散德祥。

translations.literal: At Dianmen there were the Tiger Divine Camp commandant Kunming, the assistant deputy Hengqian, the garrison camp manager Xiangrui, the garrison detachment officer Lingkui, the squad leader Yanlu, and garrison, armored cavalry, and training troops as recorded.
translations.idiomatic: At Di'anmen fell the Tiger Divine Camp commandant Kunming, the assistant deputy Hengqian, the camp manager Xiangrui, the detachment officer Lingkui, the squad leader Yanlu, and other garrison, cavalry, and training troops.

sentences.zh: 紫禁城內有護軍參領海忠，親軍校文玉。

translations.literal: Within the Forbidden City there were the garrison deputy commandant Haizhong and the imperial guard adjutant Wenyu.
translations.idiomatic: Inside the Forbidden City were the garrison deputy Haizhong and the imperial guard adjutant Wenyu.

sentences.zh: 守陴者有世管佐領德潤，馬甲錫秀。

translations.literal: Those who defended the battlements included the hereditary assistant commandant Derun and the armored cavalry Xixiu.
translations.idiomatic: Defending the walls were the hereditary assistant commandant Derun and the armored cavalry Xixiu.

sentences.zh: 巷戰者有驍騎校多倫布，藍翎長德英額、雙貴，前鋒鳳玉、希拉奔、崇安、文英、榮昆，護軍德玉、崇貴、崇福、崇興，領催鶴鳴，馬甲雙福、長海、慶裕、桂保、長升、恩立、興岱、存桂、常泰，養育兵英厚、文志、德成、俊成，幼丁元成、全祥、世增、烏凌阿、廣林、廣俊、松廕、松祺、松立、延尉、成明、廣瑞，閒散全順、頤霈、多山、慶祿，外委王文志、聞廷標、王灝、高玉、常存，百總郭立奎，管隊張海、金松林，把總王洪銘，馬兵彭玉恩、全祥，戰兵李逢春、戴永福、彭玉堂、孟祿，守兵王政樞、劉永安、季茂軒，砲甲祥通，砲手白萬泰。

translations.literal: Those who fought in the lanes included the xiaoqixiao Duolunbu, Blue Button holders, van and garrison troops, squad sergeants, armored cavalry, training soldiers, youths, unattached bannermen, external deputies, company and platoon leaders, cavalry, combat and garrison soldiers, and artillerymen as recorded.
translations.idiomatic: In street fighting fell the xiaoqixiao Duolunbu, Blue Button holders, van and garrison troops, squad sergeants, armored cavalry, training soldiers, youths, unattached men, external deputies, company and platoon leaders, cavalry, combat and garrison troops, and gunners.

sentences.zh: 死事者：寧壽宮員外郎誠年、筆帖式福臻在內值宿，七月二十一日巳刻，聞兩宮西狩，即赴各殿封鎖，至斂禧門外值房投井死。

translations.literal: Those who died in the line of duty: the Ningshou Palace vice director Chengnian and the clerk Fuzhen were on interior night duty; on the twenty-first day of the seventh month at the si hour, hearing that both palaces had gone west on tour, they at once went to seal the various halls and threw themselves into a well and died at the duty room outside the Shuanxi Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Among those who died in service were the Ningshou Palace vice director Chengnian and the clerk Fuzhen, on night duty within the palace. On the twenty-first of the seventh month, at the si hour, when word came that the court had fled west, they sealed the halls and drowned themselves in the well at the duty room outside Shuanxi Gate.

sentences.zh: 太廟五品官富亮，值班上香，洋兵突進，拒之，槍死。

translations.literal: The fifth-rank officer of the Imperial Ancestral Temple Fuliang was on duty offering incense when foreign soldiers burst in; he resisted them and was shot dead.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Ancestral Temple fifth-rank officer Fuliang was tending incense when foreign troops rushed in; he resisted and was shot dead.

sentences.zh: 織工張繼福，在綺華館被戕。

translations.literal: The weaver Zhang Jifu was killed at the Qihua Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: The weaver Zhang Jifu was slain at the Qihua Lodge.

sentences.zh: 左營參將王長廕守署不去，以獨力難持，投井死。

translations.literal: The Left Camp deputy general Wang Changyin refused to leave his yamen; seeing that he could not hold alone, he threw himself into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: Left Camp deputy general Wang Changyin would not abandon his headquarters; finding he could not hold on alone, he cast himself into a well.

sentences.zh: 護軍連升值班端門；

translations.literal: The garrison Liansheng was on duty at the Duan Gate;
translations.idiomatic: The garrison Liansheng was stationed at the Duan Gate;

sentences.zh: 護軍崇連，神機營呈遞公事步軍校賡音布、常福、勝喜，領催雙喜，馬甲存林、恩明，外委孫國瑞，技勇兵常有、隆祥、萬昭，均在廳值班；

translations.literal: the garrison Chonglian; the Shenjiying document courier and infantry adjutants Gengyinbu, Changfu, and Shengxi; the squad sergeant Shuangxi; the armored cavalry Cunlin and Enming; the external deputy Sun Guorui; and the skirmishers Changyou, Longxiang, and Wanzhao were all on duty in the hall;
translations.idiomatic: the garrison Chonglian; the Shenjiying document runners and infantry adjutants Gengyinbu, Changfu, and Shengxi; the squad sergeant Shuangxi; armored cavalry Cunlin and Enming; external deputy Sun Guorui; and skirmishers Changyou, Longxiang, and Wanzhao were all on hall duty;

sentences.zh: 領催榮鈐，養育兵定成，隊兵布興泰，均看守軍庫；

translations.literal: the squad sergeant Rongqian, the training soldier Dingcheng, and the detachment soldier Buxingtai were all guarding the arsenal;
translations.idiomatic: the squad sergeant Rongqian, the training soldier Dingcheng, and the detachment soldier Buxingtai were guarding the arsenal;

sentences.zh: 南城正指揮項同壽，在署辦公；

translations.literal: the Southern City chief commander Xiang Tongshou was handling affairs in his yamen;
translations.idiomatic: the Southern City chief commander Xiang Tongshou was at work in his yamen;

sentences.zh: 戶部書吏高世祥，總理衙門供事沈鵬儀、徐伯興、洪瑞汶，均在署值班，與於難。

translations.literal: the Hubu clerk Gao Shixiang, and the Zongli Yamen clerks Shen Pengyi, Xu Boxing, and Hong Ruiwen were all on duty in their yamens and perished in the disaster.
translations.idiomatic: the Ministry of Revenue clerk Gao Shixiang and the Zongli Yamen clerks Shen Pengyi, Xu Boxing, and Hong Ruiwen were on duty in their offices and died in the calamity.

sentences.zh: 在先陣亡者：把總李鍾山，外委李鍾林，七月十七日，在張家灣禦敵，不克，死。

translations.literal: Those who had fallen earlier: the platoon leader Li Zhongshan and the external deputy Li Zhonglin, on the seventeenth day of the seventh month, met the enemy at Zhangjiawan, could not prevail, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier casualties included platoon leader Li Zhongshan and external deputy Li Zhonglin, who on the seventeenth of the seventh month fought the enemy at Zhangjiawan, failed to hold, and were killed.

sentences.zh: 先後被難者：游擊王燮，五月二十五日在東便門彈壓拳匪，被戕，並毀其屍；

translations.literal: Those who met calamity in succession: the battalion commander Wang Xie, on the twenty-fifth day of the fifth month, was suppressing Boxers at Dongbianmen and was killed, and his corpse was destroyed as well;
translations.idiomatic: Among those who died were battalion commander Wang Xie, killed on the twenty-fifth of the fifth month while suppressing Boxers at Dongbianmen, his body afterward mutilated;

sentences.zh: 采育營部司楊光第，於閏八月二十九日聞洋兵至，衣冠坐營中，被槍死；

translations.literal: the Caoyu Camp company commander Yang Guangdi, on the twenty-ninth day of the intercalary eighth month, hearing that foreign soldiers had arrived, sat in full dress in the camp and was shot dead;
translations.idiomatic: Caoyu Camp company commander Yang Guangdi, on the twenty-ninth of the intercalary eighth month, hearing foreign troops had come, sat in camp in full dress and was shot dead;

sentences.zh: 把總張進志擁護同死。

translations.literal: the platoon leader Zhang Jinzhi died defending him.
translations.idiomatic: platoon leader Zhang Jinzhi died defending him.

sentences.zh: 均經留京辦事大臣崑岡上聞，贈卹有差。

translations.literal: All were reported upward by the minister left in the capital, Kunning, and posthumous favors were granted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Kunning, the minister left to manage affairs in the capital, reported them to the throne, and posthumous honors were granted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 崇壽，溫徹亨氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Chongshou, of the Wencheheng clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Chongshou, of the Wencheheng clan, was a Bordered Yellow Banner Manchu.

sentences.zh: 光緒十六年進士，入翰林，累擢翰林院侍讀。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Guangxu he passed the jinshi examination, entered the Hanlin Academy, and was promoted to Hanlin reader.
translations.idiomatic: He took his jinshi in 1890, entered the Hanlin Academy, and rose to Hanlin reader.

sentences.zh: 變作時，不勝憂憤，仰藥死。

translations.literal: When the upheaval came, unable to bear his grief and indignation, he took poison and died.
translations.idiomatic: When the crisis broke, overcome with grief and rage, he swallowed poison and died.

sentences.zh: 詔以「見危授命」褒之，諡文貞。

translations.literal: An edict praised him with the phrase "he met peril and gave his life," and he was given the posthumous name Wenzhen.
translations.idiomatic: The court commended him with the phrase "he met peril and gave his life" and granted the posthumous name Wenzhen.

sentences.zh: 韓紹徽，字筱珊，貴州貴陽人。

translations.literal: Han Shaohui, style Xiaoshan, was a native of Guiyang, Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shaohui, styled Xiaoshan, came from Guiyang in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十年進士，授主事，分刑部，勤於所職。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Guangxu he passed the jinshi examination, was appointed a director, and was assigned to the Ministry of Justice, where he was diligent in his duties.
translations.idiomatic: He became a jinshi in 1894, received appointment as a director in the Ministry of Justice, and worked diligently.

sentences.zh: 拳亂初起，嘗走同官，涕泣誓身殉。

translations.literal: When the Boxer turmoil first arose, he once went to a colleague in tears, vowing to die for the state.
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxer rising began, he sought out a colleague in tears and swore he would die for the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 七月二十一日，自經於陝西司司堂。

translations.literal: On the twenty-first day of the seventh month he hanged himself in the main hall of the Shaanxi Department.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-first of the seventh month he hanged himself in the main hall of the Shaanxi Department.

sentences.zh: 掌江西道御史韓培森，巡城積勞，城破，絕食死。

translations.literal: Han Peisen, supervising censor of the Jiangxi Circuit, died of starvation after exhausting himself on patrol when the city fell.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi-route censor Han Peisen, worn out from city patrols, starved himself to death when the capital fell.

sentences.zh: 內閣中書堃厚，手書「見危授命」四字，與妻同縊死。

translations.literal: The Grand Secretariat drafter Kunhou wrote by hand the four characters "he met peril and gave his life" and hanged himself together with his wife.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretariat drafter Kunhou wrote by hand the four characters "he met peril and gave his life" and hanged himself with his wife.

sentences.zh: 馬鍾祺，字維春，隸漢軍鑲黃旗。

translations.literal: Ma Zhongqi, style Weichun, was of the Chinese Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Zhongqi, styled Weichun, belonged to the Chinese Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 少為諸生，以襲一等子，例不得與試，授三等侍衛，擢二等，有文武才。

translations.literal: In youth he was a licentiate; by hereditary succession to a first-class marquisate he was barred from the examinations by statute and was appointed a third-rank bodyguard, then promoted to second rank, possessing both civil and military talent.
translations.idiomatic: As a young man he was a licentiate; inheriting a first-class marquisate barred him from the examinations by statute, so he entered service as a third-rank bodyguard and was promoted to second rank, gifted in both letters and arms.

sentences.zh: 初服膺陸、王之學，繼參以程、硃、張、呂，不主一家。

translations.literal: At first he devoted himself to the learning of Lu and Wang; later he drew also on Cheng, Zhu, Zhang, and Lü, not adhering to any single school.
translations.idiomatic: He first embraced the teachings of Lu and Wang, then incorporated Cheng, Zhu, Zhang, and Lü as well, refusing to follow any one school alone.

sentences.zh: 為人伉爽有奇氣，慕孫白谷之為人，好與朝野賢士遊，與語或不合，輒哦詩亂之，以此得狂名。

translations.literal: By nature he was forthright and possessed a singular spirit; he admired Sun Baigu's conduct, delighted in associating with worthy men throughout court and country, and when talk did not agree would chant poetry to disrupt it—thus he gained a reputation for eccentricity.
translations.idiomatic: Bold and unconventional by nature, he admired Sun Baigu, sought out worthy men high and low, and when conversation jarred would break into verse to disrupt it—hence his reputation for eccentricity.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十年，日本爭朝鮮，廷議出師，鍾祺上書請自效，遂從戎奉天。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Guangxu, when Japan disputed Korea and the court debated sending troops, Zhongqi submitted a memorial offering himself and went north to Fengtian to take the field.
translations.idiomatic: In 1894, when Japan contested Korea and the court debated war, Zhongqi petitioned to serve and marched to Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 盛京將軍依克唐阿器之，使統鎮邊馬隊。

translations.literal: The Fengtian general Yiketang'a valued him and had him command the border horse detachment.
translations.idiomatic: Fengtian general Yiketang'a esteemed him and put him in command of the border horse detachment.

sentences.zh: 會和議定，遂歸。

translations.literal: When peace was settled he returned.
translations.idiomatic: When peace was made he returned.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，李秉衡奉旨巡視長江，親訪於家，疏請從行。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Li Bingheng, commissioned to inspect the Yangtze, visited him at home and memorialized asking that he accompany him.
translations.idiomatic: In 1899 Li Bingheng, touring the Yangtze on imperial orders, called at his home and memorialized that Zhongqi accompany him.

sentences.zh: 拳匪禍作，冒鋒火而北，秉衡殉難，鍾祺護其喪歸。

translations.literal: When the Boxer calamity arose, he braved fire to go north; Bingheng died for the state, and Zhongqi escorted his coffin home.
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxer disaster broke out he went north through the fighting; after Bingheng died for the state, Zhongqi brought his coffin home.

sentences.zh: 歸三日，京師破，鍾祺自縊死。

translations.literal: Three days after his return the capital fell, and Zhongqi hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Three days after he returned, Beijing fell, and Zhongqi hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 著五倫大義、馬氏日記若干卷。

translations.literal: He left works including The Great Meaning of the Five Relationships and the Ma Family Diary in several volumes.
translations.idiomatic: He left works including The Great Meaning of the Five Relationships and the Ma Family Diary in several volumes.

sentences.zh: 候選縣丞董瀚，於城破日與弟候補巡檢徵曰：「我等職雖微末，既讀聖賢書，惟有以身殉國而已。

translations.literal: The candidate district magistrate Dong Han, on the day the city fell, said to his younger brother, the candidate assistant magistrate Zheng: "Though our offices are humble, having read the sages' books, we can only give our bodies to the state."
translations.idiomatic: Candidate magistrate Dong Han said to his younger brother, candidate assistant magistrate Zheng, on the day the city fell: "Our posts are low, but having read the sages we can only give our lives for the realm."

sentences.zh: 」同時自縊。

translations.literal: They hanged themselves at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: They hanged themselves together.

sentences.zh: 涿州附生譚昌祺，聞城陷，懷藥哭諸聖廟，仰藥死。

translations.literal: Tan Changqi, a supplementary licentiate of Zhuozhou, upon hearing the city had fallen, took poison, wept at the temples of the sages, and died by poison.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Changqi, a Zhuozhou licentiate, upon hearing the capital had fallen took poison, wept before the sage temples, and died.

sentences.zh: 舉人莊禮本，留京讀書。

translations.literal: Zhuang Liben, a provincial graduate, remained in the capital to study.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial graduate Zhuang Liben had stayed in the capital to study.

sentences.zh: 拳匪初起，即以為憂。

translations.literal: When the Boxers first arose he already took it as a cause for worry.
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxers first appeared he was already deeply troubled.

sentences.zh: 洋兵入城，痛哭不食，後以一慟而絕。

translations.literal: When foreign soldiers entered the city he wept and would not eat; afterward a single burst of grief ended his life.
translations.idiomatic: After foreign troops entered the city he wept and refused food, then died in a final paroxysm of grief.

sentences.zh: 州同銜馮福疇，在通州署辦刑名事。

translations.literal: Feng Fuchou, holding the rank of subprefect, was handling criminal matters at the Tongzhou yamen.
translations.idiomatic: Subprefect Feng Fuchou was handling criminal cases at the Tongzhou yamen.

sentences.zh: 七月十六日，敵入署，守護案牘，不屈，被戕。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth day of the seventh month the enemy entered the yamen; he guarded the case records, would not submit, and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth of the seventh month the enemy entered his office; he defended the archives, refused to yield, and was slain.

sentences.zh: 東城司吏目、練勇局委員宮玉森，洋兵攻局，其女請避，怒投其女於井，拔刀出戰。

translations.literal: Gong Yusen, Eastern City sub-bureau clerk and drill-corps commissioner, when foreign soldiers attacked the bureau and his daughter begged him to flee, in anger threw his daughter into a well and drew his sword to fight.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Yusen, Eastern City sub-bureau clerk and drill-corps commissioner, when foreign troops attacked the bureau and his daughter urged flight, in fury cast her into a well and went out sword in hand.

sentences.zh: 傷數處，自知不免，亦投井死。

translations.literal: Wounded in several places and knowing he could not escape, he also threw himself into the well and died.
translations.idiomatic: Wounded repeatedly and seeing no escape, he too cast himself into the well.

sentences.zh: 時同被難者，為原品休緻禮部侍郎景善，前奉天府尹福裕，蒙古副都統耆齡，前察哈爾副都統明秀，冠軍使文琭，工科給事中恩順，刑部郎中汪以莊，兵部員外郎薩德賀、趙寶書，吏部主事鍾傑，戶部主事陶見曾、李慕、鐵山，刑部主事毛煥樞、王者馨，工部主事白慶、恆昌，理籓院主事英順，光祿寺署丞多文，國子監助教柏山，候選道鄭錫敞，前紹興府知府繼恩，分省知縣王朝鐀等，見冊報者千餘人。

translations.literal: Those who met calamity at the same time included the former Ministry of Rites vice minister Jingshan, restored to his original rank; the former Shuntian prefect Fuyu; the Mongol deputy commander-in-chief Qiling; the former Chahar deputy commander Mingxiu; the champion commissioner Wenyu; the Ministry of Works supervising secretary Enshun; the Ministry of Justice director Wang Yizhuang; the Ministry of War vice directors Sadehe and Zhao Baoshu; the Ministry of Personnel director Zhong Jie; the Ministry of Revenue directors Tao Jianzeng, Li Mu, and Tieshan; the Ministry of Justice directors Mao Huanqiu and Wang Zhexin; the Ministry of Works directors Bai Qing and Hengchang; the Lifanyuan director Yingshun; the Guanglu Temple acting vice director Duowen; the Guozijian assistant instructor Baishan; the candidate intendant Zheng Xichang; the former Shaoxing prefect Ji'en; the provincial magistrate Wang Chaokeng, and others—more than a thousand persons appear in the registers.
translations.idiomatic: Those who perished at the same time included former Ministry of Rites vice minister Jingshan; former Shuntian prefect Fuyu; Mongol deputy commander Qiling; former Chahar deputy Mingxiu; champion commissioner Wenyu; supervising secretary Enshun; directors and vice directors across the Six Ministries and Lifanyuan; Guanglu and Guozijian officials; candidate intendant Zheng Xichang; former Shaoxing prefect Ji'en; magistrate Wang Chaokeng; and more than a thousand others recorded in the registers.

sentences.zh: 全家焚溺服毒自經以盡節者眾，騎都尉候選員外郎陳鑾，住東便門二閘，於七月十九日洋人攻城，勢急，與諸弟率眷屬僕婢三十二名，一時自盡，尤為慘烈雲。

translations.literal: Many families burned themselves, drowned, took poison, or hanged themselves to preserve their integrity. Chen Luan, a Chiduwei and candidate vice director, lived at the second lock of Dongbianmen; on the nineteenth day of the seventh month, as foreign soldiers assaulted the city and the peril grew acute, he and his brothers led wives, children, servants, and maids—thirty-two persons in all—to die together at once, a tragedy of especial severity.
translations.idiomatic: Countless families died by fire, drowning, poison, or the noose. Chen Luan, a Chiduwei and candidate vice director at Dongbianmen's second lock, on the nineteenth of the seventh month, as the assault grew desperate, led his brothers, kin, servants, and maids—thirty-two souls—to die together at once, among the most harrowing cases.

sentences.zh: 宋春華，字實菴，陝西三原人。

translations.literal: Song Chunhua, style Shian, was a native of Sanyuan, Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Song Chunhua, styled Shian, came from Sanyuan in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 光緒十二年武進士，授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Guangxu he passed the military jinshi and was appointed a Blue Button bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He took the military jinshi in 1886 and was appointed a Blue Button bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 出為天津鎮標右營守備，與士卒共甘苦，所部為天津綠營冠。

translations.literal: He went out as right-battalion garrison commander of the Tianjin brigade, shared hardship with his soldiers, and his command was counted the finest of the Tianjin Green Standard.
translations.idiomatic: Posted as right-battalion garrison commander of the Tianjin brigade, he shared his men's hardships, and his unit ranked first among Tianjin's Green Standard forces.

sentences.zh: 聯軍內犯，總督裕祿檄春華守城南門。

translations.literal: When the allied armies invaded inland, Governor Yulu ordered Chunhua to hold the southern city gate.
translations.idiomatic: When the allied armies advanced inland, Governor Yulu ordered Chunhua to defend the southern gate.

sentences.zh: 城東南製造軍械所不守，春華集其眾曰：「軍械所存亡，天津生死系之。

translations.literal: The ordnance works southeast of the city were not held; Chunhua gathered his men and said: "Whether the arsenal stands or falls binds the life and death of Tianjin."
translations.idiomatic: The arsenal southeast of the city had been lost; Chunhua assembled his troops and said, "The arsenal's fate is Tianjin's fate."

sentences.zh: 不奪歸不可，膽勇者盍隨吾出城！

translations.literal: We cannot fail to retake it—whoever has courage, follow me out of the city!"
translations.idiomatic: We must win it back—who has the heart to follow me out?"

sentences.zh: 」皆應曰：「諾！

translations.literal: All answered: "Yes!"
translations.idiomatic: They all answered, "Aye!"

sentences.zh: 」率百餘人夜半潛出，及庫垣，春華先登，眾隨之。

translations.literal: He led more than a hundred men out secretly at midnight; reaching the depot wall, Chunhua climbed first and the rest followed.
translations.idiomatic: He led over a hundred men out at midnight; at the depot wall Chunhua climbed first and the rest followed.

sentences.zh: 槍中春華左股，眾欲退，春華負創大呼曰：「今夕之事，有進無退！

translations.literal: A shot struck Chunhua in the left thigh; the men wished to withdraw, but Chunhua, bearing his wound, shouted: "Tonight's affair admits advance, not retreat!"
translations.idiomatic: A bullet struck his left thigh; as his men wavered, Chunhua, wounded, roared, "Tonight we advance—we do not retreat!"

sentences.zh: 」眾爭奪敵，死傷甚眾，卒以守堅，退歸城。

translations.literal: The men vied to seize the enemy; casualties were very heavy, but because the defenders held firm, they withdrew back to the city.
translations.idiomatic: His men rushed the enemy; losses were heavy, yet the defenders held firm and they withdrew back inside the walls.

sentences.zh: 已而敵兵日集，守土官多棄城走，春華慨語其妻陳曰：「城孤兵單，終恐不守。

translations.literal: Before long enemy troops gathered daily, and many local officials abandoned the city and fled. Chunhua said with emotion to his wife Chen: "The city is isolated and our forces few—we surely cannot hold in the end.
translations.idiomatic: Enemy forces gathered day by day, and many officials fled the city. Chunhua told his wife Chen, "We are isolated and outnumbered—the city cannot hold."

sentences.zh: 汝當以吾子出求生，吾誓與城存亡矣！

translations.literal: You must take our son out to seek life; I swear to live or die with the city!"
translations.idiomatic: Take our son and flee to safety; I will live or die with this city!"

sentences.zh: 」語畢，登陴督戰不少息。

translations.literal: When he had finished speaking, he mounted the battlements and directed the fighting without rest.
translations.idiomatic: He then mounted the walls and fought on without pause.

sentences.zh: 城既陷，身被數傷，猶死守不​​退。

translations.literal: When the city had fallen, though wounded in several places, he still defended stubbornly and would not withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he was wounded repeatedly, yet still refused to yield.

sentences.zh: 或勸少避，春華曰：「城不守，死自吾分。

translations.literal: Some urged him to withdraw a little; Chunhua said: "If the city is not held, death is my allotted portion.
translations.idiomatic: Some urged him to pull back; Chunhua said, "If the city falls, death is my duty alone."

sentences.zh: 汝曹各有父母妻子，歸可也，俱死無益！

translations.literal: You all have parents, wives, and children—go home if you can; to die together is of no use!"
translations.idiomatic: You have parents, wives, and children—go home. To die together helps no one!"

sentences.zh: 」眾感其義，無退者。

translations.literal: The men were moved by his righteousness, and none retreated.
translations.idiomatic: His men were moved, and none withdrew.

sentences.zh: 敵畢登城，乃仰天歎曰：「吾志不遂，負國恩矣！

translations.literal: When the enemy had fully mounted the walls, he looked up to heaven and sighed: "My aim is not fulfilled—I have failed the state's grace!"
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy overran the walls he looked skyward and cried, "My purpose is unfulfilled—I have betrayed the empire's favor!"

sentences.zh: 然自接戰以來，殺敵過當，今日之死，亦無所恨。

translations.literal: Yet since we joined battle I have slain the enemy beyond measure; to die today, I have no regret."
translations.idiomatic: Yet since battle began I have killed the enemy in great numbers; I die today without regret."

sentences.zh: 」以首觸陴，腦出，死，年三十五。

translations.literal: He struck the battlement with his head; his brains burst forth, and he died, aged thirty-five.
translations.idiomatic: He dashed his head against the wall; his brains spilled out, and he died at thirty-five.

sentences.zh: 馬福祿，字壽三，甘肅河州人。

translations.literal: Ma Fulu, style Shousan, was a native of Hezhou, Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Fulu, styled Shousan, came from Hezhou in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年武進士，用衛守備，歸河南鎮標，以終養告歸。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu he passed the military jinshi, was appointed garrison commander, returned to the Henan brigade, and petitioned to retire to care for his parents until their end.
translations.idiomatic: He took the military jinshi in 1880, became a garrison commander, served with the Henan brigade, then retired to nurse his parents.

sentences.zh: 二十年，循化撒拉回族以爭教叛，固原提督雷正綰檄福祿往崔家峽、樊家峽協防，戰輒勝。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the Xunhua Salar Muslims rebelled over a sect dispute; the Guyuan commander Lei Zhengkui ordered Fulu to assist in defense at Cuijia Gorge and Fanjia Gorge, and in battle he always won.
translations.idiomatic: In 1894 the Xunhua Salar rose in a sectarian revolt; Guyuan commander Lei Zhengkui sent Fulu to Cuijia and Fanjia gorges, where he won every engagement.

sentences.zh: 河、湟回匪繼起，复助官兵獲大捷。

translations.literal: Huang and Huang bandits rose in succession; he again aided the government troops and won a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: Revolts spread along the Huang and Huang rivers; he again aided the government forces to a major victory.

sentences.zh: 累功至記名總兵。

translations.literal: By accumulated merit he rose to registered brigade general.
translations.idiomatic: His accumulated merit earned him registration as brigade general.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，河州諸回變，福祿本回教，回以福祿助官軍，欲加害。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the Muslims of Hezhou rebelled; Fulu was himself a Muslim, and because Fulu aided the government army, the rebels wished to harm him.
translations.idiomatic: In 1895 the Hezhou Muslims rebelled. Fulu was himself Muslim, and because he aided the government troops the rebels sought his life.

sentences.zh: 福祿在城，人亦以回教為疑，獨正綰信之。

translations.literal: Fulu was in the city, and people also suspected him on account of his faith; only Zhengkui trusted him.
translations.idiomatic: In the city others doubted him for his faith; only Zhengkui stood by him.

sentences.zh: 時河州鎮總兵湯彥和遠駐起乍堡，命福祿率騎兵迎入河州城鎮之，彥和猶豫不果行，叛回週七十乃糾眾據山巔下擊。

translations.literal: At that time the Hezhou brigade commander Tang Yanhe was stationed far away at Qizhabao; he ordered Fulu to lead cavalry to welcome him into Hezhou city to stabilize it. Yanhe hesitated and did not go; the rebel Zhou Qishi then gathered a crowd, seized the mountain heights, and struck downward.
translations.idiomatic: Hezhou commander Tang Yanhe held distant Qizhabao and ordered Fulu to escort him into the city. Yanhe hesitated; rebel Zhou Qishi rallied men on the heights and attacked downhill.

sentences.zh: 福祿戰二日，以失地利無功。

translations.literal: Fulu fought two days but, losing favorable ground, achieved nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Fulu fought two days but, deprived of good ground, gained nothing.

sentences.zh: 彥和復潛走，軍無統帥，賊益蹙之。

translations.literal: Yanhe again slipped away in secret; the army had no commander, and the bandits pressed them all the harder.
translations.idiomatic: Yanhe slipped away again; leaderless, the army was driven ever tighter.

sentences.zh: 福祿乃突圍出南番境，至蘭州乞師。

translations.literal: Fulu then broke through the encirclement into the southern frontier and went to Lanzhou to beg for reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: Fulu broke out into the southern frontier and reached Lanzhou to plead for troops.

sentences.zh: 沿路拔出難民數千，難民德之，狀總督楊昌濬，昌濬以福祿孚眾望，乃檄與蘭州道黃雲由北路援河州。

translations.literal: Along the way he rescued several thousand refugees; the refugees were grateful to him and petitioned Governor Yang Changjun, who, seeing that Fulu enjoyed the people's trust, ordered him and Lanzhou intendant Huang Yun to relieve Hezhou by the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: He rescued thousands of refugees en route; they praised him to Governor Yang Changjun, who, trusting his standing with the people, ordered him and Lanzhou intendant Huang Yun north to relieve Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 時喀什噶爾提督董福祥奉旨赴甘肅協剿，由狄道進兵。

translations.literal: At that time the Kashgar commander Dong Fuxiang had received orders to go to Gansu to assist in suppression and advanced by way of Didao.
translations.idiomatic: Kashgar commander Dong Fuxiang was then ordered to Gansu and advanced through Didao.

sentences.zh: 福祿率師至蓮花渡，與賊隔岸相持，為福祥軍犄角，卒解河州圍。

translations.literal: Fulu led his army to Lianhua Ford and faced the bandits across the river, forming a pincer with Fuxiang's army, and finally lifted the siege of Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Fulu reached Lianhua Ford, held the rebels across the river as Fuxiang's wing, and at last raised the siege of Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 時韓文秀亦作亂，河湟提督李培榮、總兵牛師韓軍失利，陝西巡撫魏光燾與福祥會白塔寺，議進兵。

translations.literal: At that time Han Wenxiu also rebelled; the Huang and Huang commander Li Peirong and brigade general Niu Shihan's army met defeat; the Shaanxi governor Wei Guangtao met Fuxiang at Baita Temple to discuss advancing the army.
translations.idiomatic: Han Wenxiu rebelled as well; Li Peirong and Niu Shihan were defeated; Shaanxi governor Wei Guangtao met Fuxiang at Baita Temple to plan the advance.

sentences.zh: 福祿入謁，陳亂事顛末，及前後戰狀，福祥奇之，檄剿叛回冶主麻於米拉溝。

translations.literal: Fulu came to audience, set forth the disorder from beginning to end and his battles before and after; Fuxiang marveled at him and ordered him to suppress the rebel Muslim Ye Zhuma at Mila Gorge.
translations.idiomatic: Fulu reported the whole course of the rebellion and his campaigns; Fuxiang was impressed and ordered him against the rebel Ye Zhuma at Mila Gorge.

sentences.zh: 剿未盡，馬營土豪馬采哥應之，福祥部將石堯臣等告敗，福祿復分道往援，首先陷陣，斬採哥，聚而殲之。

translations.literal: Before the suppression was complete, the Ma Camp local strongman Ma Caige responded; Fuxiang's subordinates Shi Yaochan and others reported defeat. Fulu again divided his forces to aid them, was first to charge the line, beheaded Caige, gathered the enemy, and annihilated them.
translations.idiomatic: Before the campaign ended, local strongman Ma Caige joined in; Fuxiang's officers suffered defeat. Fulu split his force to aid them, led the charge, slew Caige, and destroyed the gathered rebels.

sentences.zh: 冶主麻收餘燼由黑山趨米拉，復還兵破之，斬無算，用是有驍將名。

translations.literal: Ye Zhuma gathered the embers and by Black Mountain made for Mila; Fulu turned his troops, broke them, and beheaded beyond counting—thus he gained the name of a fierce general.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Zhuma rallied remnants through Black Mountain toward Mila; Fulu turned, shattered them, and killed beyond count—hence his fame as a fierce commander.

sentences.zh: 拳匪倡亂，福祥奉旨入都，檄福祿統馬步七營、旗防山海關，尋移永平府，福祥入衛京師，檄隨行。

translations.literal: When the Boxers raised disorder, Fuxiang received orders to enter the capital and ordered Fulu to command seven horse and foot battalions to guard Shanhaiguan; soon he was moved to Yongping Prefecture. Fuxiang entered to guard the capital and ordered him to accompany him.
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxers rose, Fuxiang entered the capital and posted Fulu with seven battalions at Shanhaiguan, then Yongping. Called to guard Beijing, Fulu marched with him.

sentences.zh: 五月，各國聯軍躪楊村而西，偕漢中鎮總兵姚旺等赴黃村御之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the allied armies of the various nations trampled Yangcun and marched west; together with the Hanzhong brigade commander Yao Wang and others he went to Huangcun to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the allied armies overran Yangcun and marched west; with Hanzhong commander Yao Wang and others he met them at Huangcun.

sentences.zh: 抵廊坊，​​兩軍相接，乃令騎兵下設七覆，步兵張兩翼，敵近始發槍，倒者如僕牆。

translations.literal: Reaching Langfang, the two armies met; he then ordered the cavalry to dismount and set seven ambush lines, the infantry to spread both wings, and fired only when the enemy drew near—the fallen were like a toppling wall.
translations.idiomatic: At Langfang the armies clashed; he dismounted his cavalry in seven lines of cover, spread his infantry on both wings, and held fire until the enemy was near—then they fell like a collapsing wall.

sentences.zh: 敵彈落如雨，騎兵以散處少傷，兩翼左右复包抄其後，短兵相接，敵不支，遽卻，為庚子之役第一惡戰。

translations.literal: Enemy bullets fell like rain; the cavalry, scattered, suffered few wounds; the wings on left and right again enveloped their rear; at close quarters the enemy could not hold and swiftly withdrew—it was the first bitter battle of the Gengzi campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Bullets rained down; scattered cavalry took few hits; both wings wheeled behind the enemy; at close quarters the foreigners broke—the first savage fight of the 1900 campaign.

sentences.zh: 六月，福祥檄令攻使館，中彈歿於陣，猶子耀圖、兆圖亦死，同殉者百餘人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Fuxiang ordered an attack on the legations; he was struck by a bullet and died in the line; his nephews Yaotu and Zhaotu also died, and more than a hundred died with them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Fuxiang ordered an assault on the legations; Fulu was shot dead in the fight; his nephews Yaotu and Zhaotu fell too, with more than a hundred others.

sentences.zh: 楊福同，直隸清苑人。

translations.literal: Yang Futong was a native of Qingyuan, Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Futong came from Qingyuan in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 同治七年，投軍，累擢游擊，從討朝陽教匪。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tongzhi he entered the army, was promoted by degrees to battalion commander, and followed the campaign against the Chaoyang sect rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In 1868 he joined the army, rose to battalion commander, and campaigned against the Chaoyang rebels.

sentences.zh: 嗣以副將駐營大名，專力緝捕，以功記名總兵，分統練軍左翼馬隊，兼統天津馬步隊各營。

translations.literal: Later, as vice general he was stationed at Daming, devoting himself wholly to pursuit and arrest; by merit he was registered as brigade general, commanded the left wing cavalry of the trained army, and also commanded all Tianjin horse and foot battalions.
translations.idiomatic: As vice general at Daming he devoted himself to policing; registered as brigade general, he commanded the trained army's left-wing cavalry and all Tianjin horse and foot units.

sentences.zh: 近畿拳匪蜂起，淶水尤甚，總督裕祿檄福同率隊往。

translations.literal: Boxers swarmed in the capital region, Lishui especially; Governor Yulu ordered Futong to lead his detachment there.
translations.idiomatic: Boxers swarmed near the capital, worst in Lishui; Governor Yulu ordered Futong there with his troops.

sentences.zh: 至史家莊，伏匪邀擊，力御之，擒數人。

translations.literal: Reaching Shijiazhuang, bandits in ambush intercepted him; he resisted forcefully and captured several men.
translations.idiomatic: At Shijiazhuang ambushers struck; he fought them off and took several prisoners.

sentences.zh: 次日，又敗匪於石亭鎮，擒首要梁修。

translations.literal: The next day he again defeated bandits at Shiting Town and captured the ringleader Liang Xiu.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he routed bandits at Shiting and seized their leader Liang Xiu.

sentences.zh: 福同不忍多誅，令限日解散，留馬隊三十人鎮之。

translations.literal: Futong could not bear to execute many; he ordered them to disperse within a set number of days and left thirty cavalry to hold the place.
translations.idiomatic: Unwilling to slaughter them, he gave them a deadline to disperse and left thirty cavalry to keep order.

sentences.zh: 無何，匪以千餘眾攻留隊，福同率步兵數十馳援。

translations.literal: Before long, bandits with more than a thousand men attacked the remaining detachment; Futong led several dozen foot soldiers in swift relief.
translations.idiomatic: Soon over a thousand bandits attacked the garrison; Futong rushed dozens of foot soldiers to their aid.

sentences.zh: 將及石亭，群匪自溝中突出，白刃交下，創甚，猶格殺數人，力盡死之。

translations.literal: As they neared Shiting, the bandits burst from ditches; blades crossed; he was badly wounded, yet still killed several men in combat, and when his strength was spent, he died.
translations.idiomatic: Near Shiting the bandits sprang from ditches; blades clashed; badly wounded, he still killed several before his strength failed and he fell.

sentences.zh: 從弁孫裕清、盧興璠俱力戰死，賜卹如例。

translations.literal: His aides Sun Yuqing and Lu Xingfan also fought to the death; posthumous favors were granted according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Aides Sun Yuqing and Lu Xingfan died fighting beside him; posthumous honors followed precedent.

sentences.zh: 吳德潚，字筱村，四川達縣人。

translations.literal: Wu Desi, style Xiaocun, was a native of Daxian, Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Desi, styled Xiaocun, came from Daxian in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 性至孝。

translations.literal: By nature he was supremely filial.
translations.idiomatic: He was profoundly filial by nature.

sentences.zh: 博極群書，以進士用知縣。

translations.literal: He read exhaustively in all books and, as a jinshi, was appointed magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Widely read, he took the jinshi and was appointed magistrate.

sentences.zh: 庚子年，任浙江，西安、北京拳亂起，江山縣土匪以仇教為名，連陷江山、常山，縣人咸欲應之，德潚謂北事未定，洋人必不宜殲。

translations.literal: In the gengzi year he was serving in Zhejiang; when the Boxer turmoil arose in Xi'an and Beijing, bandits in Jiangshan County took revenge on converts as their pretext, successively seizing Jiangshan and Changshan; the county people all wished to join them. Desi said the northern affair was not settled and foreigners surely ought not to be exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: In 1900 he served in Zhejiang. As turmoil spread from Xi'an and Beijing, Jiangshan bandits used anti-convert zeal to seize Jiangshan and Changshan; locals wanted to join. Desi warned that the north was unsettled and foreigners must not be annihilated.

sentences.zh: 有羅楠者，素健訟，德潚嘗嚴懲之，久含恨。

translations.literal: There was a Luo Nan, skilled at litigation, whom Desi had once punished severely and who long harbored hatred.
translations.idiomatic: A litigious man named Luo Nan, whom Desi had once punished harshly, had long nursed a grudge.

sentences.zh: 結都司週之德，挾眾指德潚袒洋教，劫德潚縛道署轅門，盡鑷鬚髮，以利刃攢刺，洞腹死，德潚罵不絕口。

translations.literal: He joined with the commandant Zhou Zhide, led a crowd to accuse Desi of favoring foreign religion, seized Desi, bound him at the circuit yamen gate, plucked out all his beard and hair, stabbed him with sharp blades in a heap, pierced his belly, and he died; Desi cursed without cease.
translations.idiomatic: He allied with commandant Zhou Zhide, accused Desi of siding with foreign religion, seized him at the circuit yamen, shaved him bare, stabbed him to death, while Desi cursed without stopping.

sentences.zh: 子仲韜馳哭屍下，又殺之，併入縣署殺全家四十餘口。

translations.literal: His son Zhongtao rushed to weep beneath the corpse and was killed as well; they also entered the county yamen and killed the whole family of more than forty persons.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhongtao ran to mourn beneath the body and was killed too; the mob then stormed the yamen and slaughtered more than forty of his kin.

sentences.zh: 事定，卹如例。

translations.literal: When affairs were settled, posthumous favors were granted according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: After order returned, posthumous honors were granted as usual.

sentences.zh: 成肇麟，江蘇華亭人。

translations.literal: Cheng Zhaolin was a native of Huating, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Zhaolin came from Huating in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 父孺，諸生，列儒林傳。

translations.literal: His father Ru was a licentiate listed in the Confucian Biographies.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ru was a licentiate recorded in the Confucian Biographies.

sentences.zh: 肇麟由舉人官直隸知縣，遷直隸州知州，署滄州靜海，補靈壽，所至有績。

translations.literal: Zhaolin, from provincial graduate, served as Zhili magistrate, was transferred to Zhili prefect, acted at Jinghai in Cangzhou, and was appointed to Lingshou—wherever he went he achieved results.
translations.idiomatic: A provincial graduate, he served as Zhili magistrate, became prefect, acted at Cangzhou's Jinghai, and took Lingshou—every post showed merit.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十七年，京師和議梗，聯軍西上，覃及邑境，責供牲畜糗糧甚厲，肇麟壹弗應。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Guangxu peace talks in the capital stalled; the allied armies marched west, reaching his district; they demanded livestock and grain provisions with great severity, and Zhaolin would not comply at all.
translations.idiomatic: In 1901 peace talks in Beijing stalled; allied troops marched west into his district, demanding livestock and grain with brutal severity, and Zhaolin refused entirely.

sentences.zh: 俄而布政使廷雍檄至，令迎犒，肇麟自念：「不迎犒，無以全民命；

translations.literal: Shortly a dispatch came from the provincial administration commissioner Ting Yong ordering him to go out to welcome and reward the troops. Zhaolin reflected: "If I do not welcome and reward them, I cannot preserve the people's lives;
translations.idiomatic: Soon provincial commissioner Ting Yong ordered him to welcome and provision the troops. Zhaolin thought, "Without welcoming them I cannot save my people;"

sentences.zh: 迎犒，則以中國臣子助攻君父；

translations.literal: if I welcome and reward them, then as a subject of China I assist in attacking my sovereign and father;
translations.idiomatic: yet to welcome them is to aid foreigners against emperor and father;"

sentences.zh: 事處兩難，守土之義無可避，惟有一死耳！

translations.literal: the matter stands on both horns—the duty of one who holds the soil cannot be evaded; there is only death!"
translations.idiomatic: caught on both horns, a magistrate cannot escape his duty—only death remains!"

sentences.zh: 」乃繕遺牒遣人間道達府，媵之以詩曰：「屈體全民命，捐軀表素懷。

translations.literal: He then drafted a final memorial and sent a man by secret route to reach the prefecture, appending a poem: "To bend the body and preserve the people's lives, to give the body and declare one's plain integrity."
translations.idiomatic: He wrote a final report and sent it by secret courier to the prefect, with a poem: "Bend the body to save the people; give the body to show one's heart."

sentences.zh: 」李鴻章狀死事以上，謂其能伸大義，降敕褒嘉，贈太僕寺卿，諡恭恪，予世職。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang reported his death to the throne, saying he had been able to uphold the great principle; an edict praised and rewarded him, posthumously appointing him Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, with the posthumous name Gongke and a hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang memorialized his death, praising his uphold of righteousness; the throne commended him, posthumously made him Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, styled him Gongke, and granted a hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 明年，允直督請，建直隸省城專祠。

translations.literal: The next year, acceding to the Zhili governor-general's request, a dedicated shrine was built in the Zhili provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, at the governor-general's request, a shrine was erected for him in the Zhili provincial capital.
